frozen_step: original Streaming TRAIN/VAL/TEST scores, pinned by v1
step_pooling: Streaming fixed exponential pooling over whole native step including visible unlabelled history
state: 128-d GRUCell with LayerNorm on each recurrent state
memory: 4x32 causal query/key/value attention including current Step and learned-key zero-value slot, gated residual
loss: all-position composed Prefix BCE, no auxiliary loss
selection: exact per-layer epoch budget from v1; VAL Prefix AUROC, AP, lower BCE; one selected TEST
batch: seed-42 shuffled complete trajectories, greedy budget 128 labeled positions / at most 16 trajectories, over-budget trajectories alone
